text:
mia: heads up — CI SAST spike on main, PR #842. lots of new findings from the new linter upgrade, most in generated protos. can someone triage quickly?
scan-bot: AUTO: SAST run completed for commit abc123 on branch main. 18 findings: 12 low, 5 medium, 1 high. top result: `proto-gen` output includes `deprecated-unsafe-field` pattern. link: https://ci.redwood/sast/abc123
sam: quick look — the high one is flagged in `gen/telemetry/v1/metrics.proto` line 42. looks like `oneof` mapped to an `any` shim from our generator.
jordan: if it's generated we should avoid changing source proto unless generator is wrong. can you paste the exact snippet? also curious if this started after the `proto-gen@v2.1.0` bump
mia: here —

```
message Metric {
  oneof value {
    bytes raw = 3;
    string text = 4;
  }
}
```

sast flagged `raw` as potentially injectable because generator emits `unsafe_to_string` helper.
alex: yep saw similar in other repos after the generator change. root cause is the generator helper `unsafe_to_string` that doesn't sanitize byte->string conversions. we should patch generator, but short-term we can mark as false positive if there's test coverage proving no user-controlled bytes end up here.
lucy: per suppression policy we can't just suppress in CI — we need an approval flow and audit log. current suppression role is too broad (`devs:write`). can we add `security.scan-suppressor` role and require it for suppressions?
jordan: +1. also we should attach an audit entry whenever a suppression is created/removed. security-ops-bot can log to `audit.kv` or to elastic.
security-ops-bot: ACTIONABLE: Proposed RBAC change: create role `scan-suppression` scoped to `eng` teams. All suppressions must be recorded in `/audit/scan-suppressions` with fields: user, pr, rule_id, reason, expiration. (This is a suggestion, not yet implemented.)
sam: regarding CI failures — unrelated but observed: `sast` job intermittently fails with KMS decryption errors after key rotation last night. logs:

```
ERROR: KMS.Decrypt failed: permission denied for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/scan
at cloudkms/crypto.go:87
```

why would SAST need KMS? we store service-account creds encrypted for the dynamic scanner container.
mia: we rotate customer-facing KMS keys every 24h (policy), but CI uses the same key for secrets; rotation job accidentally revoked `service-account-scan@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` grant. Noted in rotation runbook.
alex: fix options: 1) grant the scanner SA `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the CI key (short-term), 2) switch to Workload Identity + short-lived tokens so KMS is only used for at-rest secret but not per-run; 3) cache decrypted secret in ephemeral store for X minutes to reduce KMS calls.
lucy: preference 2 for security. also we must ensure the RBAC change for suppression triggers an audit event stored in the same immutable audit bucket; that's a compliance requirement for SOC2.
jordan: DAST note — the staging auth proxy causes a lot of false positives for auth-by-cookie. DAST is flaky when the staging cookie expires mid-run. we should add a health-check retry and a session-refresh step in the DAST pipeline:

```
- preflight: login -> store cookie in tmp
- run dast with --cookie-file tmp/cookie
- postflight: rotate session
```

sam: agree. also add a flaky mark so the pipeline doesn't auto-fail release if DAST hits known flakiness; instead create a ticket and re-run once.
mia: proposed action items:
- alex: patch `proto-gen` to sanitize `unsafe_to_string` and release v2.1.1 (ETA 48h)
- sam: temporary RBAC lock down: create `scan-suppression` role + remove suppression perms from `devs:write` (ETA 24h)
- lucy: implement audit log hook for suppression events to `/audit/scan-suppressions` (ETA 48h)
- jordan: DAST pipeline session refresh + flaky marking (ETA 1 week)
- alex/sam: short-term KMS fix — restore SA decrypter perm and propose Workload Identity migration (create RFC, ETA 1 week)

can folks ack and I'll file follow-ups?
alex: ack. I'll start the generator patch and open a PR.
sam: ack. I'll schedule the RBAC change, will add a rollback plan.
jordan: ack. will update DAST job and add health checks.
lucy: ack. I'll own the audit implementation and coordinate with compliance.
mia: thanks everyone. I'll create the tracking ticket and link PRs here. :thumbsup:
scan-bot: NOTE: created issue SEC-1207: "SAST: generator unsafe_to_string -> patch and suppression RBAC + audit". https://issues.redwood/SEC-1207
mia: leaving this thread open until SEC-1207 is green and RBAC/audit work is merged.
